description: This stacked bar chart from the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision" compares the composition of two categories, "Ours" and "Standard," across three sub-components: "Context" (blue), "Generated Response" (orange), and "Other" (green). The horizontal axis displays the two main categories, "Ours" at the top and "Standard" at the bottom, while the vertical axis represents the percentage composition of each sub-component within those categories. The chart uses a linear scale, with percentages ranging from 0% to 100%, and the bars are stacked to show the total composition for each main category. For the "Ours" category, the blue "Context" segment is 60.6%, the orange "Generated Response" segment is 31.7%, and the green "Other" segment is 7.7%. For the "Standard" category, the blue "Context" segment is 23.6%, the orange "Generated Response" segment is 51.1%, and the green "Other" segment is 25.3%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in a grouped format, with each main category having its own stacked bar. The chart includes a legend at the bottom that maps the colors to their respective components. There are no visual emphasis or annotations beyond the percentage labels within each bar segment.
